vendor.name: Nexus Engineering & Cloud Architecture Corp.
vendor.tagline: Enterprise Distributed Systems, Cloud Migration & High-Throughput Metrology

client.attention: Dr. Elena Rostova (VP of Engineering & Data Platform)
client.project_title: Enterprise Real-Time Event Streaming & Observability Platform

deliverables.title: System Architecture Discovery & Target Topology Blueprint
deliverables.description: Comprehensive audit of existing telemetry pipelines, latency bottleneck analysis, and formal distributed event architecture blueprint based on Apache Kafka and gRPC streaming protocols.

deliverables.title: High-Throughput Streaming Ingestion Engine Development
deliverables.description: Custom Rust/C++ stream microservices engineered for multi-tenant data ingestion with zero-copy serialization, fault-tolerant partition buffering, and automated dead-letter routing.

deliverables.title: Multi-Region Kubernetes (EKS) Infrastructure as Code
deliverables.description: Production Terraform and Helm manifests configuring multi-zone cluster auto-scaling, Cilium eBPF mesh networking, mTLS zero-trust communication, and automated failover policies.

deliverables.title: Observability Mesh, SLO Dashboarding & Load Benchmarking
deliverables.description: Full Prometheus/Grafana distributed tracing instrumentation, P99 latency alert rules, chaos testing under 100k events/sec load, and formal handoff documentation with runbooks.

milestones.deliverable_summary: Architecture specification, infrastructure audit, data schema definitions, and design approval sign-off.
Streaming engine MVP deployment, synthetic ingestion load benchmarking, and staging cluster configuration.
Multi-region failover testing, zero-trust mTLS policy enforcement, SOC2 audit logging, and SLO telemetry setup.
Production cutover, automated canary deployments, runbook verification, engineer workshops, and final acceptance.
